meta_description: P Carrington is a Sheffield painter and decorator offering interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decorating services. Call 07931 761217 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Bradway-Based Painter — Quality Finishes, Local Service
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior painting, we transform your home with precision and care.
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior redecorating and wallpapering to exterior painting and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with fresh paint and wallpaper. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints to ensure long-lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Protect and brighten your home's exterior. We work in all weather conditions and use weatherproof finishes to withstand Sheffield's climate.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpapering for feature walls or whole rooms. We remove old wallpaper carefully and hang new designs with precision alignment and finish.

services.title: Textured & Feature Finishes
services.desc: Create visual interest with textured coatings, Venetian plaster, or specialty paint effects. Perfect for accent walls or period properties.

services.title: Commercial & Office Decorating
services.desc: Professional redecorating for retail spaces, offices, and rental properties. We work to your schedule and minimise business disruption.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Proper surface prep is the foundation of any good paint job. We fill cracks, sand woodwork, and repair damage before painting begins.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home looking better than I found it.
about_para_1: P Carrington has been decorating homes and businesses across Sheffield for over 15 years. Based in Bradway, we've built our reputation on thorough preparation, attention to detail, and using quality materials that stand the test of time. Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete room transformation, we approach every project with the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and deliver exactly what we promise—no surprises, no cutting corners. We treat your home as if it were our own, protecting your belongings and leaving the site clean at the end of each day. References from previous clients are gladly provided.

reviews.text: Paul came recommended by a friend and I'm so glad we called him. He completely redecorated our lounge—new wallpaper, fresh paint, the lot. Tidy, professional, and didn't rush the job. Our lounge looks absolutely stunning now. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen painted and it's like a new room. Paul was meticulous with the prep work and the finish is flawless. He was chatty but got on with the job without faffing about. Definitely having him back for the hallway next year.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Brilliant lad. We'd had a water stain on the ceiling that needed covering, plus a few walls we wanted freshening up. Paul handled it all smoothly, protected our furniture properly, and tidied up after himself every evening. Reasonable price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.
